class: A money figure shown without saying whether charges are in it: two honest numbers for the same trade read as a contradiction or hide a loss.
mechanism: Totals were computed in several places, some before charges, none labelled.

first_seen.evidence: Strategy 141 showed -32.50 while the result after charges was -435.95 (charges paid 403.45); strategy 139: -159.25 against -511.65.

fix: One engine function (book_after_charges) feeds every total; labels '(after charges)' / '(before charges)'; the breakdown is one tap away. Part B (25 Nov): one cost to close at the live price; every tile, curve, table and breakeven for a paper trade reads the paper reply and carries a basis line; the Add Booked switch moves them together (ADR-321).

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check. Some screen leftovers (P&L table rows unlabelled, charge-rates sentence) are open.

occurrences.evidence: Strategy 141 showed -32.50 while the result after charges was -435.95 (charges paid 403.45); strategy 139: -159.25 against -511.65.
